messages:
Elaine - Partnerships: Heads up partners — we're planning to change the SDK default retry/backoff behavior in the next minor release (v3.2) to enable stricter idempotency handling. This may surface duplicate side effects for non-idempotent endpoints if partners rely on implicit retries.
Mike - SDK Eng: TL;DR: default will switch from naive retry to `idempotency-aware` retries. SDKs will attach/require an "Idempotency-Key" for any request flagged as non-idempotent, otherwise we limit retry attempts.
Anita - Partner Eng: Can you spell out which endpoints are considered non-idempotent? Our HW partners call the /jobs/start endpoint a lot.
Mike - SDK Eng: Good call — non-idempotent = endpoints that create resources or start long-running jobs (e.g., /jobs/start, /models/deploy, /billing/charge). We'll publish the full list in the docs.
Sam - Platform PM: Timeline: propose branch cut for SDKs Monday 2025-02-10, public docs + release notes Wednesday, marketplace vendor notice Thursday, gradual rollout (canary) next week. Is that okay for partnerships?
Jules - Partner Success: Partners will need 2 weeks to opt into the new behavior in some cases. Can we provide a compatibility flag in SDKs so they can opt-out until they update server-side logic? :thinking_face:
Mike - SDK Eng: Yes — v3.2 will default to new behavior but include `autoRetry: 'idempotency-aware'` and a config flag `legacyRetries: true` to keep current semantics for one release cycle. We'll log a deprecation warning when legacyRetries=true.
Anita - Partner Eng: For partners using our marketplace images and 3rd party SI integrations, we should add a server-side header check fallback: if `Idempotency-Key` missing, server can set `Idempotency-Status: uncertain` in response and route to a non-retrying path. Thoughts?
Sam - Platform PM: Good idea. Add server header so integrators can detect and handle. We'll surface that in the compatibility playbook.
deploy-bot: deploy queued for canary namespace: infra/canary-sdk-idempotency-2025-02-12
Mike - SDK Eng: Example snippet we'll add to docs:
```
// enable idempotency-aware retries (default in v3.2)
const client = new Redwood({ autoRetry: 'idempotency-aware' });
// explicitly set key for non-idempotent ops
await client.post('/jobs/start', body, { headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': uuid() } });
// legacy opt-out
const legacy = new Redwood({ legacyRetries: true });
```
Elaine - Partnerships: We're drafting a partner email and marketplace banner. Key asks: (1) scan integrations for non-idempotent calls, (2) add idempotency keys where appropriate, (3) test with canary SDKs and report failures.
Jules - Partner Success: I'll include a small test harness and example script for partners to detect duplicate side effects. Also prep a rollback guide if they need to revert to legacyRetries flag.
Anita - Partner Eng: Will coordinate with hardware partners to run the harness on next firmware test cycle. Can we get a readout of common failure modes?
Mike - SDK Eng: We'll collect early telemetry from canaries: duplicate job creation, double-charges (billing), stuck deployments. We'll add a 'safety-net' that blocks automatic retries on endpoints tagged `billing` unless explicit idempotency key present.
Sam - Platform PM: Agreement: block automatic retries for billing endpoints by default in server side for v3.2 rollout. Partners must opt-in by providing `Idempotency-Key`. We'll reflect that in the vendor contract for marketplace images.
Elaine - Partnerships: Action items:
- Mike: push v3.2 canary build and PR with legacy flag + deprecation warning (by Fri).
- Docs: publish compatibility matrix + endpoint list (Mon).
- Jules/Anita: ship partner test harness and email draft (Mon).
- Sam: add server header `Idempotency-Status` + billing block (canary).
Jules - Partner Success: I'll schedule a short partner briefing (30 min) for Tue to walk through the change. Include SI integrators and channel partners. :calendar:
Mike - SDK Eng: I'll add telemetry events `sdk.retry.blocked`, `sdk.idempotency.missing`, `sdk.duplicate.detected` so we can track impact.
Anita - Partner Eng: Thanks — appreciate the opt-out flag. Any concerns about token rotations or header size limits when partners use proxies?
Mike - SDK Eng: Note in docs: keep `Idempotency-Key` short (UUID v4 ok). Proxies that munge headers will need passthrough rules.
Elaine - Partnerships: Ok team — let's run the canary next week and reconvene after 72 hours of telemetry. I'll post partner comms draft later today. :megaphone:
